Qeynos Vendors

 

Listed here are the spells on the Qeynos vendors.   It can be quite confusing to a person who has not purchased spells there before. There are two Enchanter vendors standing out side the quild. Once you go into the door, you will see a small room with vendors (I called it the Center Room) which contains more Enchanters vendors and the general vendor. Directly to your left, (the Left Room) is the Wizard vendors. In the back of the room to you right (the Right Room) is the Magician vendors. I'm not sure where the Necromancer vendors are if (if there are any) so let me know if you know where they are at.
